meta.scope: UAE Batch 9 — ADIA framing, renewable energy capacity, and climate/GHG residual under locked data specification with proposed: domains.

reports.title: Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA) sovereign wealth framing
reports.publisher: Derived from ADIA and secondary monitoring sources
reports.description: Framing of ADIA as Abu Dhabi’s traditional long-term sovereign wealth fund. Estimated assets under management in the order of US$1 trillion; invests primarily outside the UAE and is a core vehicle for intergenerational management of hydrocarbon surpluses.

reports.title: Renewable energy capacity statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from IRENA and national energy monitoring
reports.description: Statistics on installed renewable energy capacity. Capacity reached approximately 7.9 GW in 2025, driven primarily by solar PV; the UAE has a longer-term target of 23 GW by 2031.

reports.title: Biennial Transparency Report / NDC progress reporting
reports.description: Official climate transparency and NDC progress reporting submitted under the UNFCCC framework (Biennial Transparency Report and related common tabular formats).

reports.title: Energy transition and diversification framing
reports.publisher: Derived from national energy and climate sources
reports.description: System-level framing of the UAE’s simultaneous hydrocarbon production role and renewable/energy-transition ambitions. Links oil production, sovereign investment, renewable capacity expansion and climate reporting.

_dropped.why: ADIA and Mubadala are both Abu Dhabi sovereign vehicles, but no document was located that asserts a formal statistical or methodological dependency between them.
Renewable capacity feeds the energy sector of GDP and power generation, but no specific document with a quotable dependency claim was retrieved.
NDC and BTR documents reference renewable deployment, but no explicit data-dependency statement linking the two defined nodes was found in this pass.

_dropped.edge: detailed GHG inventory time series as standalone node
_dropped.why: A full national GHG inventory series would strengthen the climate layer. The BTR is the current transparency vehicle; a more granular inventory product can be added if a clean recurring official series is isolated.
